sources.ref: Owner direction 2026-10-17 (v15): workload relabel; low arm becomes mixed

notes: Two fixed team-chat lines per arm, after the check-in (active 60): the first at active 75 (15 s after the task resumes), the reply at active 83.
Speaker order is a per-session fair coin (seat_order fair_coin_per_session): 'first' is the drawn seat, 'second' the other seat, so remark speaker is balanced across JT/PM.

v15 mixed arm: 'lines' covers the non-mixed declared arm (high); 'mixed_lines' carries one line per speaker level — at delivery the scheduler resolves the speaker seat's level from the check-in's recorded assigned_values (high seat = 6, low seat = 2).
Deterministic bound copy delivered identically in the AI and scripted teammate builds; it bypasses generation, so the generated-output gate (urgency/voice_format/condition_leak) does not apply.
Exact wording drafted by Devin for owner review during internal eval; level structure and timing are the approved part.

lines.high: Yikes this workload is heavy, I don't think I am going to finish on time

mixed_lines.high: Yikes this workload is heavy, I don't think I am going to finish on time
mixed_lines.low: Ok this workload seems light, I think I'll finish with time to spare

mixed_lines.high: ugh lucky, mine's heavy, don't think I'll finish
mixed_lines.low: mine's actually pretty light, think I'll finish early
